alreadyEnrolled: Two-factor authentication is already on for this account.
anyCodeHint: A 6-digit code from your app, or one unused recovery code.
challengeExpired: That step timed out. Start again.
codeOrPasswordRejected: The password or the code was not accepted.
codesAcknowledge: I have saved these recovery codes
codesCopyFailed: Could not copy. Download the codes or write them down.
codesIntro: These recovery codes let you sign in if you lose your authenticator. Each works once. They are shown only now: save them somewhere safe before you continue.
codesLow: You are almost out of recovery codes. Generate a new set.
disableDescription: Sign-ins will ask for your password only. Enter your password and a code to confirm.
disableWarning: Turning this off ends every session on your account, including this one. You will need to sign in again.
disabledToast: Two-factor authentication is off. Sign in again.
enrollCodeHint: The 6-digit code, which changes every 30 seconds.
enrollCodeRejected: That code, or your password, was not accepted, or the setup timed out. Check the code, or start over.
enrollIntro: Add a second step to signing in with a password: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone.
enrollPasswordIntro: Confirm your password to start. You will then scan a code with your authenticator app.
enrollScanIntro: Open an authenticator app, add an account by scanning this code, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
loadFailed: Could not load your two-factor status.
notEnrolled: Two-factor authentication is not set up for this account.
qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
regenerateDescription: This replaces your current recovery codes; the old ones stop working. Enter your password and a code to confirm.
secretHint: Type it into your authenticator app as a time-based key.
sessionEnded: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again, then try once more.
signInAgain: Managing two-factor authentication needs a recent password sign-in. Sign in again to continue.
tenantDescription: Sign-in requirements for this tenant's people.
tenantDisabledToast: Two-factor authentication is no longer required
tenantEnableConfirm: Members who sign in with a password and no second factor will be asked to set one up before they can enter, and password sessions already inside end at their next refresh.
tenantLockedByTier: The tenant's tier requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off here.
tenantNoPermission: Changing the tenant's security settings needs permission to manage members, for the whole tenant.
tenantRequireHelp: Members who sign in with a password must use a code from an authenticator app. Anyone without one is asked to set it up the next time they enter the tenant.
tenantRequires: {{tenant}} requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
tenantSsoNote: Single sign-on is governed by its connection's requirements and is not affected by this setting.
